summary: Candidate is semantically identical to two existing micro_skills in the same asset layer (micro_skill, granularity micro, asset_node_id micro_skill_node, asset_level 3). All three cover the same capability: terminating an AgentOps session with a status label and finalizing telemetry. The candidate and peer skills c864553d and 7cb8564a are near-duplicates with minor wording differences in workflow steps and cautions. Merging into the most complete existing skill (7cb8564a, which shares the exact name and objective) eliminates redundancy. Peer candidate 7b643d32 (Agent Operation Span Tracking) is a distinct capability (decorator-based operation tracking, not session termination) and should not be merged.
